_about: Checked facts for the 39 mid-tier questions, so every run counts WRONG answers, not only answered / partial / not found. A reply is wrong when it fails a check: `any` = at least one group of figures must all appear in the exact wording (Answer.exact), `must_not` = a pattern that must not appear in the reply. Questions without an entry are unchecked. Figures were checked on Oct 29 against the budget tables (structured core, page given) or are printed rows a run quoted.
